title: Keep: history judged by ancestry, never by list order
description: git-vouch:1096-1177 (History) and check_registry's lowered() at 1755-1767. Positions are compared only with before()/concurrent() over the ancestor bitsets, never by topo index or committer date. Where two concurrent branches race (authority lost on one, used on the other), the record is void until re-approved, because git does not record which came first. The index and the dates are controlled by whoever authors the merge, so 'simplifying' to index or date order would let a contributor choose the outcome by how they merge. vouch-faq3.13 (dates for query --at) is the one place dates decide anything, and it is tracked as a weakness, not a model to copy. Separately, git-vouch-migrate loading git-vouch as a module (git-vouch-migrate:35-50) instead of copying its parsers is what keeps the two tools agreeing; keep it.
close_reason: Kept (Mark 2026-10-23); History docstring now says ancestry, never index or date, dates only as faq3.13 effective dates; comment at git-vouch-migrate _load_vouch on loading, not copying
